title: India in the Human Development Report 2025
body: The Human Development Report 2025 of the United Nations Development Programme, titled 'A Matter of Choice: People and Possibilities in the Age of AI', placed India at rank 130 out of 193 countries, up from rank 133 in the previous year's assessment. India's HDI value rose from 0.676 in 2022 to 0.685 in 2023. Commentators noted that, after two difficult pandemic years, India's recovery had been strong in the three areas the index measures: a long and healthy life, access to knowledge and a decent standard of living. They also warned that rising inequality remains a challenge, because the index reports national averages of attainment. The same report classifies countries as very high (score above 0.800), high (0.700 to 0.799), medium (0.550 to 0.699) and low (below 0.550) in human development.
